title: Marshall Brown's loudspeakers blamed for the hypertension
summary: Marge believes the loud electronic equipment Marshall Brown placed next to Zutty's drums at his job, leaving him unable to hear, raised his blood pressure.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well when Zutty had this stroke what ......
What caused it? Do you know what caused it? (Unintelligible?).
Marshall Brown, Brown got loud speakers and that electronical equipment in there and put it right by Zutty.
And he stayed over on the other end.
And he was on the other end and all the noise was going into Zutty's ears, you know. With this electronic equipment, where he was blowing his trombone and all. And Zutty would come home every night

and tell me how bad he felt and he couldn't even hear. When I talked to Zuddy he said, huh. Honey can't you hear? He said, no Marge I can't hear what you're saying. What did you say? And I told, and then I would go in a room after Zuddy came home and he's sitting on the side of the bed. And I said, Zuddy if you're going to let that job worry you like that why don't you quit? I said, you know what, you know what I told him? I said, you're only bringing your blood pressure up.
I said, you know one thing, you're bringing your blood pressure up. And sure enough he was. And I still say that's what caused this hypertension. That thing liked to worry Zuddy to death.
